name: SMZDM
text:
#!name=什么值得买
#!desc=某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思
#!homepage=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts
#!icon=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/icons/gif/naisi-01.gif
#!raw-url=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/raw/main/Loon/plugin/split/partS/SMZDM.lpx

#!date=2026-11-11 21:17:23
#############################################


[Argument]
smzdm_enable = switch,true,false,tag=什么值得买-脚本开关

[Rule]
DOMAIN, aaid.uyunad.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, acs4baichuan.m.taobao.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, adashxgc.ut.taobao.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, analytics-api.smzdm.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, baichuan-sdk.alicdn.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, dgstatic.jd.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, msg.umengcloud.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, sec.umeng.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, ulogs.umeng.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, ynuf.aliapp.org, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, res-ga.smzdm.com, REJECT


[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/haojia\.m\.smzdm\.com\/detail_modul\/other_modul\?/i then reject_dict(200)




[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/haojia\.m\.smzdm\.com\/detail_modul\/user_related_modul\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/smzdm_ads.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="什么值得买去广告", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/haojia-api\.smzdm\.com\/ranking_list\/articles\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/smzdm_ads.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="什么值得买去广告", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/s-api\.smzdm\.com\/sou\/filter\/tags\/hot_tags\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/smzdm_ads.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="什么值得买去广告", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/s-api\.smzdm\.com\/sou\/list_v10\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/smzdm_ads.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="什么值得买去广告", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/user-api\.smzdm\.com\/vip\/creator_user_center/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/smzdm_ads.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="什么值得买去广告", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/user-api\.smzdm\.com\/vip$/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/Smzdm.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="什么值得买去广告", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 感谢【怎么肥事】分享
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app-api\.smzdm\.com\/util\/loading/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/Smzdm.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="Smzdm", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app-api\.smzdm\.com\/util\/update/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/Smzdm.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="Smzdm", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/user-api\.smzdm\.com\/vip\/bottom_card_list/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/Smzdm.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="Smzdm", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/haojia-api\.smzdm\.com\/home\/list/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/Smzdm.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="Smzdm", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/homepage-api\.smzdm\.com\/v3\/home/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/Smzdm.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="Smzdm", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/article-api\.smzdm\.com\/publish\/get_bubble/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/Smzdm.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="Smzdm", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/qianbao\.smzdm\.com\/v\d\/app\/home/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/smzdm/Smzdm.js") with enable=${smzdm_enable}, tag="Smzdm", timeout=60, requires_body=true




[MITM]
hostname = homepage-api.smzdm.com, haojia-api.smzdm.com, app-api.smzdm.com, user-api.smzdm.com, article-api.smzdm.com, qianbao.smzdm.com, s-api.smzdm.com, haojia.m.smzdm.com
